account:
It is day 0, just after 10:00, and I am at the plaza for my scheduled market walk. So far I have heard no reports of trouble or unusual town business. Townsfolk 30 and Townsfolk 20 both told me they had no news; Townsfolk 10 is nearby but I have not yet asked them. Earlier, the secretary said no correspondence or confirmed news had reached them.

The one unresolved detail is my 15:00 tea appointment: the appointment book says only 'Tea with the neighbour, dockside cottage (east bank),' without naming the host or giving a precise address. The secretary asked whether I had an invitation; I do not. I returned the appointment book and asked the secretary to check the address without changing today's engagements. Since then I have seen the secretary walking from the town hall through the plaza toward the east bank, holding a writable book. This may be an effort to find the tea address, but I have not heard confirmation. I heard them talking during my walk, but could not make out the words.

The rest of my schedule is lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at 13:00, tea at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow at 10:00 there is a grain inspection at the mill. Nothing I have observed yet establishes any larger unusual event or purpose beyond ordinary town routines and clarifying the tea appointment.
